title: Coin Change
goal: Solve Coin Change: Bottom-up DP where dp[i] = min coins to make amount i.
strategy: Bottom-up DP where dp[i] = min coins to make amount i.
edgeCases: An unreachable amount needs a failure sentinel rather than zero coins; coins may be reused.
inputRules: coins must be array of numbers
amount must be a non-negative integer
